The '''Art virus''' was a [[mechu-deru]] [[Nanovirus|technovirus]] developed by the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Cronal]]. Following Cronal's [[Battle of Mindor|defeat]] at [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], he embraced the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] art of mechu-deru and blended it with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to create [[Stygian Art|Stygian art]].<ref>{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> After fleeing to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Andooweel/Legends|Andooweel]], Cronal developed his Art virus to transform the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] into an [[Empire of Art]].<ref name=":0">''[[Collapsing New Empires|"Collapsing New Empires" —]] [[Star Wars Tales 19]]''</ref> The virus functioned similarly to [[Belia Darzu|Belia Darzu's]] [[Nanogene spore|nanogene]] technovirus.<ref>''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Fueled by living flesh, Cronal's mechu-deru [[Nano-droid/Legends|nanodroids]] were capable of transmuting both organic beings and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] into Stygian [[Technobeast|technobeasts]]. Cronal infected [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnant]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], and their symbiotic insects with his virus. When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] discovered his operations in [[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were infected with the Art virus by insects that had been transformed into micro-droids. These micro-droids also infected the circuitry of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] hand. Luke was able to cut off his arm before the virus spread to the rest of his body, and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was able to short circuit Cronal's technobeasts with a [[Corellian spark grenade]].<ref name=":0" />
